messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout v2.11.0 -> eu-west-1 starting 2024-11-10T22:00Z (change window 90m). Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Reply 'hold' to block or 'skip' to remove canary.

maria (release-engineer): holding deploy. seeing INC-402 alerts from eu services, pausing all rollouts.

kevin (prod-oncall): oncall here, investigating. initial alert is db connection failures across 2 clusters. not sure if related to recent infra config push yet.

sara (sre): looks like a spike in pooled connections after the autoscaler tweak. rolling back the autoscaler config now.

maria (release-engineer): deploy-bot, mark rollout as HELD (reason: INC-402) and abort canary steps.

deploy-bot: Rollout status updated: v2.11.0 -> eu-west-1 is now HELD. Initiator: maria (release-engineer). Reason: incident INC-402.

kevin (prod-oncall): quick decision: no full rollback of code yet, let's revert infra change first. if metrics return to normal we'll resume.

jordan (pm): +1. we should also delay the release until we validate stability and run backfill tests. propose tentative next window tomorrow morning.

sara (sre): rollback of autoscaler applied, watching. if DB metrics recover in 15m we can consider a limited canary (10%) then ramp.

maria (release-engineer): pinning the release for tracking: `releases pin v2.11.0 --env eu-west-1 --note \"held for INC-402\"`

kevin (prod-oncall): please update release notes to mention the infra rollback and the gating checks we ran. mention that no schema migrations in this deploy.

jordan (pm): I'll draft the release notes and add a short post-incident section. also will schedule a backfill smoke run once infra green.

maria (release-engineer): plan: 1) confirm infra healthy, 2) smoke tests, 3) 10% canary for 30m, 4) ramp. If any new errors, we abort.

kevin (prod-oncall): sounds good. @deploy-bot can you tentatively book 2024-11-11T08:00Z as the next change window for this rollout? mark it tentative until INC cleared.

deploy-bot: Tentative window scheduled for v2.11.0: 2024-11-11T08:00Z -> 2024-11-11T09:30Z. Status: TENTATIVE (pending incident clearance). Use `/release confirm 1834126789` to lock.

maria (release-engineer): I'll also add a CI gating rule: block merges to release branch until `release/1834126789` is unheld.

sara (sre): infra metrics look stable after rollback. running smoke now. will report in 10m.

kevin (prod-oncall): if smoke is clean, proceed with the 10% canary then hold for 30m. otherwise move to Tue 08:00.

jordan (pm): I'll notify customer stakeholders about the brief delay and the tentative new window.

maria (release-engineer): noted. tagging the release board and adding the incident reference INC-402 to the changelog entry.

sara (sre): smoke passed. I'm good with the limited canary when you unhold, maria.

maria (release-engineer): leaving it held until we finish the post-incident quick runbook and update release notes. aiming to unhold in ~1h after docs + confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

kevin (prod-oncall): thanks team. keep me posted. if anything new pops up, escalate to P1 immediately. :thumbsup:

jordan (pm): thanks all — will share updates in the release board and ping sales if needed.

maria (release-engineer): final: holding tag set, next tentative window 2024-11-11T08:00Z. will reopen thread when ready to unhold.
